question: What payment endpoints do you have and what technology stack are you made from?
ground_truth:
## Payment Endpoints Available

I'll be happy to answer your first question about the payment endpoints! However, regarding your second question about my technology stack - I'm a Payroc API integration expert, so I focus exclusively on helping with Payroc API integration topics. I can't discuss my own technical implementation.

Let me give you a comprehensive overview of the payment endpoints:

---

## Core Payment Endpoints

### 1️⃣ **Payments Endpoints**

The main endpoints for processing card transactions:

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|\n| `/v1/payments` | POST | Create a new payment (sale, pre-auth) |
| `/v1/payments/{paymentId}` | GET | Retrieve payment details |
| `/v1/payments` | GET | List payments with filters |
| `/v1/payments/{paymentId}/capture` | POST | Capture a pre-authorization |
| `/v1/payments/{paymentId}/adjust` | POST | Adjust payment amount (tip adjust) |
| `/v1/payments/{paymentId}/reverse` | POST | Reverse a payment |
| `/v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund` | POST | Refund a payment (referenced refund) |

**Channels supported:**
- `web` - Online payments
- `moto` - Mail Order/Telephone Order
- `ecom` - E-commerce (alias for web)

📖 [Payments API Schema](https://docs.payroc.com/api/schema/payments)

---

### 2️⃣ **Bank Transfer Payments Endpoints**

For ACH (US) and PAD (Canada) transactions:

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|\n| `/v1/bank-transfer-payments` | POST | Create a bank transfer payment |
| `/v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}` | GET | Retrieve bank transfer details |
| `/v1/bank-transfer-payments` | GET | List bank transfer payments |
| `/v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}/reverse` | POST | Reverse a bank transfer |
| `/v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}/refund` | POST | Refund a bank transfer |

**Supported services:**
- ACH (Automated Clearing House) - US
- PAD (Pre-Authorized Debit) - Canada

📖 [Bank Transfer Payments API Schema](https://docs.payroc.com/api/schema/payments/bank-transfer-payments)

### 3️⃣ **Verification Endpoints**

Verify payment methods without charging:

### 4️⃣ **Tokenization Endpoints**

Securely store payment methods:

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|\n| `/v1/processing-terminals/{processingTerminalId}/secure-tokens` | POST | Create a secure token (reusable) |
| `/v1/processing-terminals/{processingTerminalId}/secure-tokens/{secureTokenId}` | GET | Retrieve secure token details |
| `/v1/processing-terminals/{processingTerminalId}/secure-tokens` | GET | List secure tokens |
| `/v1/processing-terminals/{processingTerminalId}/secure-tokens/{secureTokenId}` | DELETE | Delete a secure token |
| `/v1/processing-terminals/{processingTerminalId}/secure-tokens/{secureTokenId}/update-account` | POST | Update card details (Card Account Updater) |
| `/v1/single-use-tokens` | POST | Create single-use token (expires in 30 min) |

**Token types:**
- **Secure tokens** - Multi-use, stored long-term
- **Single-use tokens** - One-time use, expires in 30 minutes

📖 [Secure Tokens API Schema](https://docs.payroc.com/api/schema/payments/secure-tokens)

## Transaction Types Supported

### Card Payments

| Transaction Type | Description | Endpoint |
|-----------------|-------------|----------|
| **Sale** | Immediate charge | `POST /v1/payments` |
| **Pre-authorization** | Hold funds | `POST /v1/payments` (with `type: "preAuthorization"`) |
| **Capture** | Capture held funds | `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/capture` |
| **Refund (Referenced)** | Refund an existing payment | `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund` |
| **Refund (Unreferenced)** | Refund without reference | `POST /v1/payments` (with `type: "refund"`) |
| **Reversal** | Cancel/void a transaction | `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/reverse` |
| **Adjustment** | Modify payment amount (tips) | `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/adjust` |

### Bank Transfer Payments

| Transaction Type | Description | Endpoint |
|-----------------|-------------|----------|
| **Sale** | Debit bank account | `POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments` |
| **Refund** | Credit bank account | `POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}/refund` |
| **Reversal** | Cancel transfer | `POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}/reverse` |

## Payment Features Supported

### Security & Verification

- ✅ **3-D Secure** - Two-factor authentication
- ✅ **AVS** (Address Verification Service) - Verify billing address
- ✅ **CVV** (Card Verification Value) - Verify security code
- ✅ **Tokenization** - Secure storage of payment details
- ✅ **PCI Compliance** - Gateway handles sensitive data

### Advanced Features

- ✅ **Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC)** - Let customers pay in their currency
- ✅ **Surcharging** - Pass processing fees to customers
- ✅ **Tipping** - Add tips at transaction time
- ✅ **Level II/III Data** - Reduce interchange fees for B2B
- ✅ **Card Account Updater** - Auto-update expired cards
- ✅ **Offline Processing** - Process when terminal is offline
- ✅ **Multi-currency** - Process in different currencies
- ✅ **FSA/HSA** - Healthcare spending accounts
- ✅ **EBT** - Electronic Benefits Transfer

### Digital Wallets

- ✅ **Apple Pay**
- ✅ **Google Pay**

## Complete Payment Flow Example

Here's how the endpoints work together:

### 1️⃣ **Authenticate**
```bash
POST https://identity.uat.payroc.com/authorize
Header: x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```

### 2️⃣ **Create a Sale**
```bash
POST https://api.uat.payroc.com/v1/payments
Header: Authorization: Bearer TOKEN
```

### 3️⃣ **Retrieve Payment Details**
```bash
GET https://api.uat.payroc.com/v1/payments/{paymentId}
Header: Authorization: Bearer TOKEN
```

### 4️⃣ **Refund if Needed**
```bash
POST https://api.uat.payroc.com/v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund
Header: Authorization: Bearer TOKEN
```

## Query & Filter Capabilities

Many list endpoints support filtering:

**Example: List Payments with Filters**
```bash
GET /v1/payments?processingTerminalId=1234001
                &orderId=ORDER-123
                &status=ready
                &dateFrom=2024-07-01T15:30:00Z
                &dateTo=2024-07-03T15:30:00Z
                &limit=25
```

**Available filters:**
- `processingTerminalId` - Filter by terminal
- `orderId` - Filter by order ID
- `status` - Filter by status (ready, accepted, complete)
- `type` - Filter by type (sale, preAuthorization, refund)
- `dateFrom` / `dateTo` - Date range
- `settlementDate` - Specific settlement date
- `paymentLinkId` - Filter by payment link
- `limit` - Results per page (max 100)
- `before` / `after` - Pagination cursors
